name: Bloomreach
tagline: Bloomreach is a composable digital experience platform that uses AI to deliver personalized product discovery, site search, and marketing automation for e-commerce brands. Its AI engine learns shopper behavior to improve search relevance, recommendations, and merchandising rules.
